title: MOKA: Moral Knowledge Augmentation for Moral Event Extraction
findings: The paper did not present any specific findings related to religion or 'People of Faith'. The findings focused on political ideology, moral framing in news media, and the performance of the proposed MOKA model for moral event extraction.
